mapper.insert: insert into conversations (id, user_id, title) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{title})
mapper.select: select id, user_id, title, created_at, updated_at from conversations where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} for key share
select id, user_id, title, created_at, updated_at from conversations where user_id = #{userId} order by updated_at desc
mapper.delete: delete from conversations where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: update conversations set title = #{title} where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
update conversations set updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
